d.ko: Embark on a puzzle- and secret-filled adventure in a handcrafted toy-world. Crack mysteries, exploit game mechanics, ignore the main quest, get out of bounds. Hunt for powerful new abilities to unravel this vast, interconnected world… And don't forget to save the princess.

d.zh: 成为手工制作的玩具世界里的小人。探索、解谜、无视主线、跳出边界、找寻隐藏区域、追查杀人犯。寻找强大的新能力来探索这个广大写相互联系的世界... 以及别忘了把公主救出来。
